scheme_name: Laptop Purchase Assistance Scheme- Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
other_conditions: Worker must be employed in a factory or institute within Gujarat
Worker must have contributed to the Labour Welfare Fund for at least one year at the local office
Benefit is for the child who has passed the Class 12 board exam with 70% or more marks
Child must be admitted to a professional or design course in India
Admission abroad makes the child ineligible
The laptop must be purchased in the name of the student
Application must be made within six months of purchasing the laptop in the same year
benefits_summary: Provides up to 50% of the laptop cost or ₹25,000, whichever is less, for eligible students, subject to a maximum laptop price of ₹50,000.
